senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָרַץ to frighten) powerful, violent man.—Pl. עָרִיצִים.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:3:12">Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00829"><he>רָמַס</he></cite>.
